Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

Meat or fish meze, many small plates one after the other. 77 reviews mention it, one lists calamari, anchovies, octopus, souvlaki and short ribs for two.

Grilled octopus

Served with lemon and potatoes. Among the 200 reviews we read, 12 mention the octopus, one calls it the best they ever ate.

Home cooking

Moussaka, kleftiko, stuffed peppers and dips such as taramosalata. Among the 200 reviews we read, 13 mention the moussaka.

Coffee and sweets

Kathodon is also a coffee shop. Guests mention the Cypriot coffee, the sweets and the house iced tea.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Right at the crossing

Among the 200 reviews we read, 17 mention the location by the border crossing, and several like watching the street from the tables outside.

Live music

15 reviews mention live music, others the Greek music playing inside.

Something on the house

8 reviews mention a free dessert, some also a glass of mastic at the end of the meal.

A taverna on the way

Kathodon is at Ledras 62D, at the end of the pedestrian street, just before the crossing point. Inside, the walls are covered with framed pictures; outside, tables stand under long awnings along the street. It is open every day from 10:00 to 23:00.

What guests say

Three of 1,656 Google reviews, 1,162 of them with five stars.

“Mixed mezze was delicious and perfect amount of food for two (calamari, anchovies, octopus, pork souvlaki, chicken souvlaki, beef short ribs and side dishes) Also recommend the service and atmosphere. Would definitely go back!”
